mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 90 degrees with clear skies at the Verona Community Park. The moon is in its waning gibbous phase, and although it is too early to see it, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 3:31 AM, rising near Verona High School in the northwest and traveling toward the east northeast near Fitchburg.

The City of Verona has installed a new piece of public art titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics in Century School Park. Carved from a reclaimed ash tree by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland, this seven foot sculpture depicts animals in traditional Tai Chi poses and was donated by local resident Gerri Gurman.

You have plenty to do with trivia happening today at both Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Yoga session at Insight Wellness, the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, or Wednesday trivia nights at Lake Lou-ee and The Bogey Factory.

In a noteworthy call from August 30, officers were dispatched to the 800 block of North Edge Trail after a man intentionally smashed a vehicle window and fled the scene; the department has since issued an arrest warrant.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:00 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a delicious treat.
